headline: KeyBanc Downgrades Carpenter Technology on Softer Guidance
summary: KeyBanc has downgraded its stock rating for Carpenter Technology following softer guidance from the company.

impacts.name: Carpenter Technology
impacts.why: Analyst downgrades and cautious corporate guidance frequently reduce short-term institutional buying interest.

why_moved: Analyst downgrades driven by lowered forward guidance alter investor sentiment and prompt downward revisions in near-term equity valuations.
